text: Nimbus Robotics is a fictional company founded in 2021 by Dr. Elena Marchetti in Turin, Italy.
The flagship product of Nimbus Robotics is the HarvestHop R9, an autonomous strawberry-picking robot.
The HarvestHop R9 can pick up to 1,200 strawberries per hour using a soft silicone gripper that avoids bruising the fruit.
As of 2025, Nimbus Robotics employs 340 people across its offices in Italy and France.
The Nimbus Robotics research lab is called the BlueLeaf Center and is located in Lyon, France.
Since 2023, the CEO of Nimbus Robotics has been Marco Bellini, who previously led a solar-energy startup.
The newest Nimbus Robotics prototype, the SkyVine D2, is a small drone that pollinates greenhouse tomato plants.
Nimbus Robotics reported annual revenue of 48 million euros in 2024, a 60 percent increase over 2023.
The HarvestHop R9 runs for nine hours on a single battery charge and recharges fully in ninety minutes.
Nimbus Robotics plans to open its first North American office in Montreal, Canada, in 2026.
